description: Escape hatch to call any Merchant API v1 path directly, for endpoints without a dedicated tool (e.g. "accounts/v1/accounts/123/issues" or the one-time "accounts/v1/accounts/123/developerRegistration:registerGcp"). The path must include the sub-API prefix (accounts/v1, products/v1, datasources/v1, promotions/v1, reports/v1, issueresolution/v1, quota/v1, inventories/v1, ...). `query` adds URL query parameters (e.g. dataSource for productInputs writes, updateMask for PATCH); `body` is sent as JSON. Can create, modify and delete data — use the dedicated tools when one exists.

path.description: Relative API path incl. the sub-API prefix, e.g. "accounts/v1/accounts/123/issues".

name: raw_request
title: Raw Merchant API call
